activities.title: Society Pool Swimming Adventures
activities.instructions: Head down to use your society's pool for fun, sustained movement in the water. Start by having your child hold onto the pool edge or a kickboard to practice flutter kicks with long, straight legs. Next, guide them in practicing basic front paddle strokes, pretending their arms are big windmills scooping water behind them. To build physical stamina, play a continuous game where they swim short widths between you and the steps to collect floating toys, keeping active for 20 to 30 minutes.

activities.title: Clubhouse Tennis Rally
activities.instructions: Head down to your clubhouse courts with a junior racquet and a few low-compression or foam tennis balls. Start with a simple warm-up by balancing a ball on the racquet while walking along a court line, then practice tapping the ball upward continuously. Move on to gentle underarm tosses back and forth across a short distance or over the net, encouraging your child to track the ball closely and make contact with the center of the racquet strings.
